note:
Acquisitions Incorporated (2019).

The effect ids are those of the items imported by DDB Importer; an item from another source keeps the general rules of the
engine, and the parts of a rule that name an id do nothing on it.

records.name: Cartographer's Map Case
records.why: Travel and map features with ability checks; nothing in combat.

records.name: Chronolometer
records.why: Start-of-turn d6 roll giving an extra action or a reroll, plus a reaction granting an action to another; data lacks the timing.

records.name: Coin of Decisionry
records.why: Social and divination flavor features; no combat effect.

records.name: Dimensional Loop
records.why: Phase shift imposing disadvantage on attacks against you, and a reach trick without opportunity attacks; data has only save bonus and vision.

records.name: Documancy Satchel
records.why: Document, storage and scroll features; nothing in combat.

records.name: Elder Cartographer's Glossography
records.why: Advantage on geography-related checks only; not a combat matter.

records.name: Failed Experiment Wand
records.why: Random choice between two spells, upcast by charges spent, with a destruction roll at zero charges; data lacks the random pick and scaling.

records.name: Far Gear
records.why: Saving throw bonus and Intimidation advantage in effects, but the custom aberration summon and bane use need rules the data lacks.

records.name: Living Loot Satchel
records.why: Storage and requisition features; nothing in combat.

records.name: Obviator's Lenses
records.why: Once per dawn advantage on a weapon attack plus one extra damage die on a hit; data has no such rider.

records.name: Occultant Abacus
records.why: Reaction to grant advantage or disadvantage on a creature's roll, and d10 grants to other creatures; data lacks these triggers.

records.name: Portfolio Keeper
records.why: Business cards and social spells; no combat effect.

records.name: Rotor of Return
records.why: Save bonus is in data, but the stored-point teleport as a bonus action needs a rule; data lacks it.

records.name: Sending Stone
records.why: Communication item with checks; nothing in combat.

records.name: Spyglass of Clairvoyance
records.why: Terrain mapping with a check; no combat effect.

records.name: Timepiece of Travel
records.why: Dex save bonus is an effect, and the cast activities and daily use cover the spells; directions are non-combat.

records.name: Travel Alchemical Kit
records.why: Tool proficiency and concealment; nothing in combat.

records.name: Wheel of Stars
records.why: Reaction adding or subtracting a d10 on another creature's roll, once per dawn; data lacks the trigger and choice.

records.name: Whisper Jar
records.why: Recording, lore and detection spells; no combat automation needed.

records.name: Distort Value
records.why: Illusory change of an object's perceived value; no combat effect

records.name: Fast Friends
records.why: Charm with repeat save if asked to act against its interest, advantage if fighting it, ends on certain death; data only applies charmed

records.name: Gift of Gab
records.why: Memory edit of recent speech; nothing acts in combat

records.name: Incite Greed

rule.adds: A charmed target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns.

records.note: Incite Greed (AI p.76): the effect lets its bearer repeat the save at the end of each of its turns.

records.name: Jim's Glowing Coin
records.why: Distracted creatures get disadvantage on Perception checks and initiative rolls; data has a save but no effect with those penalties

records.name: Jim's Magic Missile
records.why: Three darts, crit uses fixed 5d4, and a natural 1 on any missile makes all miss and hurt the caster; data has a plain attack

records.name: Motivational Speech
records.why: Temp HP, advantage on Wis saves, advantage on next attack after being hit, ends when temp HP lost; data lacks the effect
